body.name: boundary-aware band-to-program handle
body.construction: Set \(h_n=\{\log(8n/\alpha)/n\}^{1/(2\beta+2)}\) and form a deterministic half-open partition \(\mathscr P_n\) subordinate to the known rectangles, with cell diameter at most \(h_n\), cell area at least \(h_n^2/8\) for all sufficiently large \(n\), no cell crossing a connected component, and deterministic boundary assignment. Let \(\widehat g_n\) be the cellwise mean of \(\Delta Y\), set equal to zero on an empty cell, with \(r_n=Gh_n^\beta+2B\sqrt{128\log(8N_n/\alpha)/(nf_0h_n^2)}\). Set \(\widehat\nu_n=n^{-1}\sum_{i=1}^nS_i\delta_{X_i}\), \(q_n=2(2M+L\operatorname{diam}(X_0))\sqrt{\log(8/\alpha)/(2n)}\), \(\widehat T_n=n^{-1}\sum_iS_i\Delta Y_i\), \(\widehat A_n=n^{-1}\sum_i|Z_i|\), \(t_n=4B\sqrt{\log(16/\alpha)/(2n)}\), and \(a_n=\operatorname{diam}(I)\sqrt{\log(16/\alpha)/(2n)}\). Choose a deterministic component-respecting \(s_n\)-net with \(s_n\le h_n\), and let \(\widehat B_n\) contain its baseline projections and every observed \(X_i\). The polytope \(\widehat{\mathcal U}_n^{\mathrm{out}}\subset\mathbb R^{\widehat B_n}\) imposes \(|v(x)|\le M\), all pairwise \(L\)-Lipschitz inequalities, and \(|\widehat g_n(d_j,z_j)-v(d_j)|\le K|z_j|+r_n\) at every support-mesh point. Define \(\widehat{\mathscr F}_n=\{(v,j,t,a):v\in\widehat{\mathcal U}_n^{\mathrm{out}},\ |j-\int v\,d\widehat\nu_n|\le q_n,\ |t-\widehat T_n|\le t_n,\ |a-\widehat A_n|\le a_n,\ a\in[a_0,\operatorname{diam}(I)]\}\). When this set is nonempty, apply the Charnes--Cooper transformation and select the lexicographically least optimizer of each of the two resulting linear programs; their clipped objective values are \(\widehat L_n=\max\{-K,\inf_{(v,j,t,a)\in\widehat{\mathscr F}_n}(t-j)/a\}\) and \(\widehat U_n=\min\{K,\sup_{(v,j,t,a)\in\widehat{\mathscr F}_n}(t-j)/a\}\). If the feasible set is empty or these clipped values cross, reset \(\widehat L_n=-K\) and \(\widehat U_n=K\). Define \(\widehat{\mathrm{CI}}_n=[\widehat L_n,\widehat U_n]\).
